author: China Insights
description:
Taiwan KMT politics took a sudden turn when Cheng Li Wen saw her high-profile US visit canceled by National Security Council officials.

This video examines the diplomatic fallout surrounding the canceled NSC meeting and what it signifies for Taiwan opposition party relations with the United States. We break down the timeline of events leading up to June 10th, 2026, and analyze the implications of the US side abruptly calling off the engagement. This breakdown is intended for observers following US Taiwan relations and the shifting dynamics of regional diplomacy.

By reviewing the details of this trip, you will understand the current friction points between key Taiwanese political figures and American policymakers. We clarify the context of the visit and why the outcome proved disappointing for the KMT leadership.

Subscribe for weekly geopolitical breakdowns and comment below with your thoughts on the future of US Taiwan relations.
title: Cheng Li Wen’s US Trip Disaster: A Sign of Shifting Taiwan Policy?
